description:
1:) Focus on user creating theme using theme builder or directly using from design
2:) Complete color schemes for light and dark with clear differentiation between color usage.
3:) Using ReplyM3 name for theme to highlight M3 of colorScheme and theming.

comments.body: I think we should change this to `replyColorScheme` to align with the `replyTypography` naming
Hmm I actually think the color schemes should go in `Color.kt`
I think we can keep this as `ReplyTheme` (otherwise the naming for other things should probably also change eg. `replyM3DarkColorScheme` which would be a bit messy IMO)
I filed a bug for the theme builder about this, but... We should change these from snake_case to PascalCase
I think it's fine to be in theme because default project also generate colorSchemes in Theme.kt and Color.kt just contains color codes for reference. Many of our samples follows this as well.
Yes I noticed I will raise it to material team as well 👍🏽 Please share link of buganizer if you have.
